## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. English or Chinese is welcome; maintainers can help with an English summary and title.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their scope. Distinguish unit/local integration, browser substitutes, native desktop and real remote tests. Note skipped/unavailable environments; every platform/service is not required for every PR.

## Related impact

Mention affected documentation, translations, generated bindings or security/lifecycle contracts when relevant. Remove secrets and sensitive output before submitting.
